tools.name: add_working_days
tools.description: Add (or subtract) working days under a NZ statute's definition. Returns the date, the section cited and the holidays skipped. The start date is not counted.

tools.name: count_working_days
tools.description: Count working days after from_date up to and including to_date under a rule.

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: List the working-day rules with their section reference, text and version.

tools.name: nz_holidays
tools.description: NZ public holidays (actual and observed dates) and provincial anniversary days for a year (2020-2030). Optional region, e.g. 'wellington'.

tools.name: validate_ird
tools.description: Free: check an NZ IRD number's check digit (Inland Revenue written steps; IRD's Example 3, 150000026, contradicts those steps and is reported invalid).

tools.name: validate_nz_bank
tools.description: Free: check an NZ bank account number (Inland Revenue algorithm). Checksum only; branch not verified against the Payments NZ register.

tools.name: validate_abn
tools.description: Free: check an Australian Business Number's checksum (ABR algorithm).
